title: Nuke The Gay Whales For Jesus
summary: A browser game: fly, drive, swim and jetpack a patriotic aerial ministry against whales. Play it free.
seoDescription: Nuke The Gay Whales For Jesus: a free browser game by Sebastian Harder with falling sand, flowing water, burning wood and rigid wrecks. No install needed.
description:
A browser game: fly (and drive, and swim, and jetpack) a patriotic aerial ministry against whales, in a world made of falling sand, flowing water, burning wood and rigid wrecks.

It runs in any modern browser with nothing to install. The game is still being built, so expect it to change often.
